title: Filtering the products table by text

steps.title: Keep rows where name is Amlou Spread 200g
steps.prompt:
WHERE is a sieve: only rows that pass the test stay.
Text values wear quotes, like 'Amlou Spread 200g'.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT * FROM products WHERE name = 'Amlou Spread 200g';
hints: Wrap the text value in single quotes.
Write: SELECT * FROM products WHERE name = 'Amlou Spread 200g';
steps.expected_sql: SELECT * FROM products WHERE name = 'Amlou Spread 200g';

steps.title: Search with LIKE for names starting 'Aml'
steps.prompt:
LIKE searches by pattern using the % wildcard.
Aml% means 'starts with'.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT * FROM products WHERE name LIKE 'Aml%';
hints: Write: SELECT * FROM products WHERE name LIKE 'Aml%';
steps.expected_sql: SELECT * FROM products WHERE name LIKE 'Aml%';

steps.title: Search with LIKE for 'mlo' anywhere
steps.prompt:
Putting % on BOTH sides matches the text anywhere.
This %mlo% means 'contains'.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT * FROM products WHERE name LIKE '%mlo%';
hints: Wrap the text in %% on both sides.
Write: SELECT * FROM products WHERE name LIKE '%mlo%';
steps.expected_sql: SELECT * FROM products WHERE name LIKE '%mlo%';
